author_or_institution: Statistics Bureau of Japan, Ministry of Internal Affairs and Communications (released May 29, 2026; bulletin June 25, 2026)
title: Preliminary Counts of the 2025 Population Census of Japan
book_use: Chapter 9; The Shrinking Century; Checked 2026-09-02; Supports: 123.05 million total population as of Oct. 1, 2025; decline of 3.097 million / 2.5% from 2020; Tokyo metropolitan area 36.986 million / 30.1% of Japan; population decreased in 1,558 of 1,719 municipalities; Limits: The agency explicitly labels these preliminary counts; manuscript should not call them final census totals.
